name: Notice
description:
Information that belongs to a place on the page — always rendered there, never injected
(R9.1). The tone's icon leads; text stays in text colours so it reads in every palette.
For transient outcomes use a toast; for connection state use the status bar.
signature: ({ tone, title, action, compact, className, children, ...rest }: NoticeProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: action
props.description: One trailing control: a small Button or a link.

props.name: compact
props.description: One line that truncates; the full text is available on hover and keyboard focus.

props.name: title
props.description: A short bold lead-in. Optional: most notices are one sentence.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
